_comment: TEMPLATE, NOT A CONFIGURATION. Every number below is a placeholder taken
from train_crops.py at github.com/Gunkartan/geospatial f5f1a6a, and none of
them was selected for this cascade: they were chosen on a pixel split
against a flat 14-class head, not on a parcel split inside a three-stage
router. Replace each block with the winner of its own search.
THE SEARCH BUDGET, matched to E4 (the only cleanly-tuned part of the SVM
comparator): 24 candidates x GroupKFold(3) on parcel_id_row, over fold 0
only, scored by f1_macro, per stage. Run xgb_search.py, which implements it.
SEARCH WITHOUT WEIGHTS, REFIT WITH THEM. E4 searched Stage 2 unweighted and
applied the subtype-mass weights only in the final refit. That is a quirk,
but it is what the comparator did, so the XGBoost search matches it rather
than fixing it in one arm only.
NO EARLY STOPPING. n_estimators is a grid axis. Early stopping would make
its evaluation rows part of model selection, and there is no partition left
that could host them: fold 1 is calibration plus operating point, fold 2 is
Run with: ALGO=xgb CLASS_WEIGHT=subtype PARAMS=configs/<your file>.json
and select ALPHA2/ALPHA3 with sweep_operating_point.py on fold 1's
calibration half -- your own values, not E7's 0.4/0.5.
